assessment_summary: Step 0003 incorrectly cites the Fundamental Theorem of Algebra (which concerns the roots of polynomials) instead of the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic to justify the unique prime factorization of integers. This incorrect justification renders the step invalid. (Note: Furthermore, the alternative inductive proof provided in Step 0005 is mathematically flawed because it assumes that $n+1$ can be decomposed into smaller factors, which is false if $n+1$ is prime.)
